entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I hope you can help. I need to return my VeloBand Pulse monitor. I'm just so upset about this whole situation.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with the product. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken or anything. I just can't use it. Right after it was delivered, my dad had a major health emergency. I had to rush him to the hospital and he ended up needing unexpected surgery.
Oh my, I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope he's doing okay now.

He's recovering, but it's been... a lot. I was at the hospital day and night. I just got back and realized I'm past the return period I saw online. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really, really could use that money back right now with all these medical bills. I feel terrible asking.

Please, don't feel terrible at all. Family comes first, and that sounds incredibly stressful. Let me take a look at your account and see what's going on... Okay, I see your order. You received it 14 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. I thought I only had 10 days.
Well, you don't need to worry one bit. Our return policy is actually 90 days from the delivery date. You are well within the timeframe for a full refund. There's no need for any special exception.
Wait, really? Ninety days? Oh, that's... that's a huge relief. I must have misread something. Thank you so much, Diana.

Of course! I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund processed in 3-5 business days.
You have no idea how much this helps. Thank you again. And thanks for asking about my dad.
It's my pleasure. I'm glad I could make things a little easier for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your father a speedy recovery.
